order: Execution Order: Entry-State Indicator (2 October 2026), section 1
label: DIAGNOSTIC
label_reason: the validation registered in reports/entry_state_validation_registration_2026-10-02.md has not reported; until it does the state is a rule output, not evidence
prices: split-adjusted daily OHLC as charted (yfinance auto_adjust=False); total-return (adjusted) closes only for the validation's returns

trend.rule: pass when the 12-month return excluding the last month (close 21 sessions ago over close 252 sessions ago, minus 1) is positive and the close is above the 200-day average; fail = AVOID

setup.rule: any of: close more than atr_mult x ATR(14) below the 20-day average; RSI(14) at or below 40; close in the lowest quarter of the 40-session high-low range (today included). Absent: WAIT (extended; buying strength)

trigger.rule: while the setup holds: a close above the prior session's high, or, after a close below the prior 40-session low (today excluded), the first close back above that low within the window. Setup without trigger: WATCH

event.rule: an earnings release within the next 20 sessions halves the size: READY-HALF; otherwise READY. An unknown date is shown as unknown and does not halve

stop.rule: stop = max(40-session low (today included) - 1 ATR, the 200-day average). A READY state arms the stop of its trigger day; a later close below the armed stop is a stop breach: logged, the stop disarmed, the state re-evaluated (AVOID or WATCH)

size.rule: shares = risk_budget x account value / (entry - stop), halved at READY-HALF, reduced until the name's post-entry share of book risk is below 40 percent. Entry = the close at READY; the next session's trigger level (today's high) at WATCH; none at WAIT or AVOID

methods.atr: simple mean of the true range over 14 sessions
methods.reference_check: reproduces the order's 1-Oct values for INCY and CPAY (tests/test_entry_state.py)
